zh: 修复 iOS 应用图标 Alpha 通道限制，确保 App 成功通过 App Store / TestFlight 验证。
增强微信本地库媒体检索与解码功能，支持会话图片、视频、文件及语音导出。
优化移动端抽屉手势控制器结构，提升交互响应流畅度与代码可维护性。
en: Fix iOS app icon alpha channel to comply with App Store and TestFlight validation requirements.
Enhance WeChat vault media queries with support for session image decoding, video, file, and voice exports.
Refactor mobile shell drawer gesture controller to improve touch responsiveness and maintainability.
